name: A due day beyond the end of the month falls on its last day
title: SC-07-10-02 A due day beyond the end of the month falls on its last day
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site's due day is 31
When period "2027-02" is accrued
Then every liability of period "2027-02" is due on "2027-02-28"
